record.question: How many health and wellness centers are typically under one Primary Health Centre (PHC)?
record.explanation: Answer C: 6. IPHS 2022 service planning typically links a Primary Health Centre to several sub-centres/HWCs; six is the closest listed typical number, though actual coverage varies by geography and population. Source/context note: HWC counts vary by state, geography, and facility arrangement; “typically” needs a stated service-area standard. Reference: https://www.nhm.gov.in/images/pdf/guidelines/iphs/iphs-revised-guidlines-2022/04-SHC_HWC_UHWC_IPHS_Guidelines-2022.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
